newsitem.title: USA: Western Gas plans Pinnacle Reef facilities.
newsitem.headline: Western Gas plans Pinnacle Reef facilities.

text.p: Western Gas Resources Inc said Thursday it will build a 200 million cubic feet per day natural gas processing plant in East Texas and that Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend producers have reserved half of the plant's capacity.

Western, through its Pinnacle Gas Treating Inc subsidiary, will construct a gathering and sour-gas treating facility near Bethel, Texas, capable of handling a minimum of 200 MMcf per day of gas, the company said.
This first phase is expected to cost about $35 million, with a completion date anticipated in April 1997.
It will be financed using available credit under the company's revolving credit facility, Western said.

The company said it signed long-term gathering and treating agreements with Sonat Inc, United Meridian Corp, Aspect Resources LLC and MB Exploration LLC covering their interests in the Cotton Valley Lime Formation of the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend in East Texas.

The agreements cover a specified area of dedication in eight counties of Texas, covering some 230,000 acres of undedicated interests in the trend. Additional acreage that may be acquired by these producers in the area of dedication will also become subject to the agreement.

Western said it plans to construct a 45-mile, 20-inch trunk line south from the plant site to existing production in the Pinnacle Reef play. The company will expand trunk lines to the north and east as the dedicated acreage is developed.
